programme.title: Hidden Histories
programme.desc: Internationally renowned historian and broadcaster, James Holland, takes a deep dive into key events from the Second World War, bringing incredible stories to life for a new generation, and offering new research and analysis to enhance our understanding of the most consequential war of the 20th Century. Each episode follows Holland buddying up with a fellow expert companion to explore the locations, characters and hardware that bring each story to life. Holland and his guests travel to Lyon to learn about the downfall of the French Resistance leader, Jean Moulin; to Rauray to follow an epic tank battle; to Monte Cassino in the footsteps of the incredible Polish forces, and across the UK to explore how the development of a single aircraft contributed to making possible the D-Day landings. On location, we get a sense of how each story played out, alongside Holland's re-telling, and the interpretation of its importance and impact as he analyses each event with his companion, illustrated with archive imagery, records and animated sequences.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Spec Miata Hammers Down at the Track. We show you painting tips on how to properly prep your aging clear coat for paint. Then we give our Mazda a fresh look before heading to the track to test those performance parts!

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Chevy C-10 - Part 5: Tunnel Vision. A '72 Super Cheyenne, Project Cream Puff; cutting and shaping fenders to install new wheel tubs for a cleaner look and accommodate a lowered stance.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Project Fat Stack: Restoring The 1971 Chevy Caprice Front Grille. Face Value - For their 1971 Chevrolet Caprice, the guys restore a hard-to-find grille and finish the fuel system to fully power the supercharged LS.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Pit Pass at a NHRA Race Weekend. Meet the graduates of SAMTech who have found a home in NHRA racing.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Driveway Rescue: Help for a '79 F100. Helping a viewer it's time to breath some life into a 1979 Ford F100. From spark to fuel we find some problems and we've got some solutions to get his ride back on the road!

programme.title: XOR - Xtreme Off-Road
programme.desc: JL Rubicon: Tires and Under Armor. Our Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon gets brand new tires and some much needed under armor. Plus, our 2001 Tacoma gets a spray-on bed liner.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Adding 315HP to a 2016 Mustang GT with a Stage 2 Supercharger. From stock to rock, Tommy and Marc introduce the EBC Brakes Mustang GT Giveaway Car and give it more power!

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Firing Up The JunkMail Jeep For The First Time. We start the final push getting Junk Mail one step closer to the trail. We tackle our wiring, plumb up our cooling and fuel systems. Then, we fabricate our exhaust before firing the '78 Postal Jeep up for the first time.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Yard Time. Our 1969 Pontiac GTO, Project Henchman, needs to bulk up before breaking out, so Tommy and Peyton are using the time to modify the chassis and install new fuel lines on this tough prisoner.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The Unbreakable Suburban is Going Off Road. The guys put Project Unbreakable, our '91 Chevy Suburban, to the test at Adventure Off Road Park! From trails to mud we'll see it all! Plus, we're off to a viewer's house to rescue the interior of her 1966 Chevy C10.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Boosted 4. 3L V6 Makes Over 500 lb-ft On The Dyno!. We crank up the power on our old-school GM 4. 3L V6 with some turbocharged forced induction.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Honda Civic Rally Ripper Gets Safety & Seat Upgrades. Our '96 Honda Civic Rally car gets some racing seats for comfort and a rally cage for added safety.

programme.title: XOR - Xtreme Off-Road
programme.desc: Pre-Runner Ranger Part 2. We're getting our Coyote engine and transmission installed in our 2002 Ford Ranger!

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Transforming a Honda Civic Hatchback Into The Ultimate Rally Car Part 1. We find a parked Honda Civic and try to get it back on the road. Then take it to the shop and start planning what to build.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Buttoned Up & Shipped Off: The Classic Bronco Gets Its Final Assembly. The guys work hard to finish their 1974 build under the hood, under the frame, and under the top because this prized new Bronco will be on its way to the SEMA Show in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Buttoned Up & Shipped Off: The Classic Bronco Gets Its Final Assembly. The guys work hard to finish their 1974 build under the hood, under the frame, and under the top because this prized new Bronco will be on its way to the SEMA Show in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: 1000 Horsepower on a Budget? And Rebuilding a Windsor 351. There's No Replacement for Displacement! The Windsor powerplant is getting stroked, plus can this offroad Big Block Chevy bullet make 1000 Horsepower?

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Supercharged Coyote. The students at SAM TECH build a supercharged Coyote engine to compete at the drag strip.

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Diesel Deconstruction. With Dragonali about to get torn down, we discuss what goes into planning and building your diesel project truck.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Waking Up Our Caddy Hearse With A New Exhaust & Fuel Upgrades. Our '76 Caddy gets help to make that engine come to life. We install a custom exhaust, & add fuel and air goodies to make Overtaker rise from the ashes.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Adding More Horsepower To The Abandoned Chevy Silverado Salvage Yard LS Swap. The Carcass crew brings their abandoned Chevy project back. They'll add some mild performance upgrades to the engine. Plus, spruce up the interior and exterior with fresh pieces.

programme.title: HorsePower
programme.desc: Restarting a '55 Chevy 350 Small Block After Sitting for Over 10 Years. A champion Pro Stock racer pitches in to bring a '55 Chevy back to life. And the guys will install and test some new supercharger technology.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: 69 GTO Part 10 - Pane Relief. We upgrade a '69 GTO with new glass, power windows, and a complete interior makeover.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Chevy M1010 is Transformed Into Willy's Wagon. Jeremy Weckman and Jimmy King transform an under powered surplus military ambulance into an iconic Willys Wagon.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Hear The Willys' 383 Stroker Small Block Chevy Roar. The Willys Mud Wagon gets a 630HP powerhouse that screams, and Jeremy and Jimmy take FrankenRegal out for a mudding adventure.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Blown 383 Stroker Has Trouble on the Dyno: What Happened?. The crew from Carcass needs plenty of power to move their 1-ton military truck. Our answer: supercharge a 383 ci V8!

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Low-Fi S-10: This Project is Coming Together. We are on the home stretch of our '95 Chevy S-10 Mini Slam Project. We begin to button things up, including the driveshaft, exhaust, shocks and more. The end is in sight as we get closer to laying frame.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Installing a Cooling and Fuel System in a Cobra Foxbody. Our '81 Mustang Cobra gets fuel and cooling systems and Project Street Regal gets some upgrades to its dated interior.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Toughening Up The '91 Suburban With New Axles And A 4-Link Coilover Kit. Our GMC "Unbreakable" Suburban gets its new suspension along with a good sanding and paint job to help get it ready for the real world.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Toughening Up The '91 Suburban With New Axles And A 4-Link Coilover Kit. Our GMC "Unbreakable" Suburban gets its new suspension along with a good sanding and paint job to help get it ready for the real world.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Building Bigfoot: What It Takes To Create A Monster Truck. We take a road trip to the outskirts of St. Louis to meet with the team responsible for Bigfoot! We have access to the inner workings, get a sneak peek at a new Bigfoot, and we're going to drive a monster truck!

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Turning a '76 Cadillac Hearse Into A Torque Monster. We take a '76 Cadillac Hearse and start turning it into a torque monster that will scream down the track starting with the drivetrain.

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Slammed '65 C10 Fleetside. The '65 C10 Fleetside gets a coilover conversion that will slam her to the ground!

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Resurrecting A '67 Camaro From Nightmare To Dream Car. We pay it forward helping to resurrect a Camaro that is more than just a car for its owner. And we'll head to Las Vegas to meet some Matco Tools merchants who believe in making a living through giving.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Cruisin' Caprice Wagon. The Carcass builders bring in an old 1984 Chevrolet Land Yacht to give it some custom touches for some family fun. They will tear down and clean up 40 years of dirt, then start replacing worn out suspension parts to get this wagon road worthy.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: 427ci LSx Part 2. The 427-ci LSx engine for Music City Trucks' C10 is being completed with EFI and dyno-tuning.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: A Greek Odyssey by Rail. In Greece, the Intercity Express travels from Thessaloniki to Athens, passing sites like the Meteora peaks, Delphi ruins and the Acropolis; the journey continues to the Peloponnese on Greece's last cogwheel train.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: Andalusia's Scenic Railways. Andalusia, now crossed by high-speed and modernized rail lines, unveils its rich culture and landscapes; along the journey, we visit cities like Seville, Granada with its famed Alhambra and Guadix near the Tabernas desert.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: Italy's Culture by Rail. The Cinque Terre Express runs along Italy's northern coast east of Genoa; passing through five UNESCO-listed villages, it offers coastal views and access to cobbled streets, harbors, terraced vineyards and pastel-colored houses.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: Corsicas' Beauty by Train. Corsica, the Island of Beauty, is best explored by railway; from Mediterranean waters to towering peaks, stops include Algajola for a seaside dive, Vizzanova on the GR20 trail and historic cities like Corte with its citadel.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: A Colorful Portugal by Rail. In Portugal, in the Douro River Valley, a steam locomotive and a small historic train will take you in turn to the water's edge, on the only railroad line in the world that crosses three World Heritage Sites classified by UNESCO.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: Eastern Pyrenees Rail Adventures. The Little Yellow Train winds through the Eastern Pyrenees, crossing the Cerdan plateau, the historic Gisclard railway suspension bridge and the Grandes Canalettes caves, known as the underground Versailles of the Pyrenees.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: The Italian Job. Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: The French Connection. Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: The Highland Fling. The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia. Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Tuscan Farmhouse Classics. Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.title: Exploring Mexico's Kitchen with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Chiles Rellenos. This recipe does not require many ingredients, but what it does require is a solid gameplan, and good technique. Rick Bayless will walk you through the dish's preparation step by step, and the outcome is well worth the wait.

programme.title: Exploring Mexico's Kitchen with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Enchiladas a la Plaza. On the streets of Morelia, you will find Enchiladas a la Plaza, a wondrous style of enchilada in which a spoonful of richly flavored vegetables is piled atop (not inside) seared, red chili-flavored tortillas. Here is Rick's delish recipe.

programme.title: Exploring Mexico's Kitchen with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Enchiladas Suizas. Though these are more traditionally made with chicken, Rick's favorite version is made with a mixture of roasted vegetables. For this recipe, he calls for a modest amount of cheese melted on top, but you can always add more.

programme.title: Exploring Mexico's Kitchen with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Ponche. Warm and fruit-filled, ponche is the traditional punch served at Christmastime posadas in Mexico. Serve it without alcohol or spike it con piquete ("with a little bite") by adding white rum.

programme.title: Exploring Mexico's Kitchen with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Tamales. The very best tamales are made from fresh-ground corn masa, and fresh-rendered pork lard. You can make delicious tamales with alternative ingredients, as well. First, Rick outlines the equipment and basic ingredients you will need.

programme.desc: Corina prueba su lealtad. Casillas recibe la ubicación del Secretario de Seguridad, Castillo, en bandeja de plata, tal como Corina se lo prometió. El Cabo niega la alianza de Quezada. Quiere al pez gordo solo para él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas secuestra a Castillo. Casillas y sus hombres raptan a Castillo y lo liberan, con la condición de que encarcele al presidente de México. Zuleta chantajea a Terán y logra que acepte la junta con el Cabo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Todos en contra de Casillas. El Cabo y el presidente pactan eliminar a Casillas. Teran obtendrá votos y control de los carteles y el Cabo su venganza. Zuleta mintió y queda en evidencia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas tiene nueva conquista. Rumbo a Turquía, Casillas y Ámbar Maldonado van por negocios y desatan el juego de la seducción: el Águila blanca debe sacar el demonio que ella lleva por dentro. Corina esta celosa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Quezada destrona al Cabo. Quezada y sus hombres matan a sangre fría a los lugartenientes del Cabo y se quedan a cargo de un laboratorio, dejándole claro con quien debe negociar. Casillas y Ambar pasean, como enamorados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: A la caza de Aurelio Casillas. El Cabo y sus aliados del narcotráfico regresan para ser dueños del negocio y acabar con Casillas y todos los integrantes de su familia. Hieren a Ismael y Javier es víctima de un atentado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas declara la guerra. En cadena nacional, Aurelio Casillas desafía a los narcos de Colombia y deja mal parado al presidente. Se escabulle en medio de un operativo policial. Corina le revela que es de la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas encierra a su amante. La agente especial de la DEA le asegura a Casillas que no lo vendió y está dispuesta a dar su vida por él; pero Aurelio no le cree. Javi despierta, desmemoriado. Quezada prepara su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas encierra a su amante. La agente especial de la DEA le asegura a Casillas que no lo vendió y está dispuesta a dar su vida por él; pero Aurelio no le cree. Javi despierta, desmemoriado. Quezada prepara su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Atacan a Casillas y a Rutila. Llega la hora de la venganza y Leandro Quezada tiene la oportunidad de deshacerse de El Señor de Los Cielos y de su hija. El Cabo ordena a Jaime conseguirle una cita con el presidente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas en el infierno turco. Con una verdadera demostración de fuerza y dominio de las armas, Casillas y Maldonado huyen de los turcos en el camión de oro venezolano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio saca su lado oscuro. Para no perjudicar su campaña, el padre de Jaime le pide a Omar que, por favor, se aleje de su hijo. Corina le dice a Aurelio que la muerte de Quezada fue una farsa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se molesta con Ambar. Casillas desconfía de Ambar al leer una nota en la que lo cita en el muelle y se excusa por un asunto urgente. Un turco pasará las tres toneladas de oro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ambar sorprende a Casillas. Casillas amenaza a Ambar con lanzarla del avión, pero ella trae consigo, un detonador nuclear. Rutila halla una pista de Javi en la selva. Quezada consigue a su doble, para despistar al enemigo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Ambar, tal para cual. Aurelio y Ambar son de la misma especie, hacen negocios por la adrenalina y el gozo que les produce; no por dinero. La DEA cae en la trampa de Quezada, llega al laboratorio, pero es un señuelo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Acorralan a Casillas. Quezada mantiene su mentira con alfileres, exige la complicidad de El Cabo y el silencio a la guerrilla para engañar a Casillas. Navarro felicita a Corina, pero aún desconfía de su lealtad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La DEA tras El Cabo. Castillo toma una foto de Milton Jiménez y la comparte con los jefes como parte del plan para acabar con el narcotráfico. Kashi le miente a Milena. Ambar entrega el detonador a los terroristas.

programme.desc: Casillas provoca al diablo. Aurelio deja en claro que él manda en el negocio y reta a Valdés, segundo al mando de la Revolución cubana, a que se pronuncie. Recibe silencio por respuesta. Casasola interviene para conciliar.

programme.desc: El Cabo se enamora. Milton Jiménez queda deslumbrado con la belleza de Evelina, la prometida del Pastor Felipe, por quien se deshace en halagos y le da una jugosa limosna. Casillas huye de Cuba y arrestan a Ambar.

programme.desc: El Cabo al descubierto. Casillas alista una lluvia de plomazos contra el Cabo, luego de enterarse de que es el responsable de los ataques a su familia en Veracruz y otros atentados. Rutila trata de asociarse con su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila se reencuentra con Javi. Tras conocer la buena noticia, Rutila llora de emoción y viaja a Colombia para abrazar a Super Javi. El Cabo consuela a la viuda, Evelina. Valdes presiona a Ambar con el oro, o va al calabozo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo roba terreno a Aurelio. Casillas descubre que el presidente protege al Cabo. Mientras, el colombiano ejecuta a sus hombres y le roba espacios al Señor de los cielos. La DEA va contra Zuleta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila seduce a Super Javi. Rutila lleva a Javi a Las Minas del Coltan y deja que sus curvas y el contacto de la piel hagan más por su memoria que el sonido de las palabras. Zuleta y Omar están en complot frente a Castillo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas mueve su ficha. Aurelio secuestra a la periodista Uzcategui, la intimida y le exige que consiga citas con los candidatos presidenciales para hacerles una propuesta. El Cabo promete cambiar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo vs. el presidente. El presidente de México, borracho y drogado, amenaza a el Cabo y el colombiano advierte, que si no hay resultados, la sociedad se cae. Aurelio no imagina qué le espera cuando se tope con Diana.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas se burla del régimen. Sorprendiéndolo con los pantalones abajo, Casillas se ríe de Valdés y le da una propinita para sacárselo de encima y compensar las bajas causadas en la Isla. Diana le miente al Chivo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Javi y Rutila salvan a Kashi. Super Javi y Rutila se la juegan por Kashi cuando Garanon la ataca. Castillo investiga la muerte de Gilberto y conoce a Diana. Preparan la bienvenida a Valdés en México.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio evalúa presidenciables. Capaz de poner y quitar presidentes a su antojo, Casillas secuestra a Begona Morejon y pone en duda, si quiere subir al poder para beneficiar a los ricos, a los pobres o a su club de amigos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas va por la droga legal. Para acabar con la guerra, Casillas plantea el comercio legal de las drogas a la candidata, Morejon; pero no esta dispuesta a negociar. Evelina firma, desconfiada, los papeles a el Cabo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ámbar debe entregarse a la DEA. Corina alerta a Casillas que su extradición inmediata está aprobada, así que el obliga a Ámbar a ir con la DEA y seguir sus instrucciones.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila enfurece con Súper Javi. Antes que Javier lo descubra, Rutila prefiere revelarle que el presidente fue su amante, y su reacción, cae como una bomba que desata una discusión. El Cabo y Evelina recorren los templos.

programme.desc: Inválido caliente; Los 40's son los nuevos 20's. Amanda quiere emanciparse para casarse con un inválido hombre mucho mayor que ella, pero su padre se opone. También, Michelle se enamora de Alex y lo trae a Estados Unidos, pero ella sospecha algo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Dos mujeres y un José; Soloterapia. Dayani usa una aplicación para buscar relaciones sexuales, pues una foto la atrae. Además, Julio financió la reconstrucción vaginal de su esposa, pero su terapia incluye la penetración del doctor.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por las buenas o las malas; La explotadora. Daniel es una chica con aspecto masculino y, para cambiar su identidad, necesita a sus papás. Por otro lado, Paola es la asistente personal de Sandra, una modelo que la sobreexplota.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Entre perros y gatos; Hijo putativo. El perro de Jenifer atacó al hijo de Juan y lo mordió. En un nuevo ataque, Juan mató al perro. Por otro lado, Fabio quiere la emancipación de Deyanira porque fue ella quien envenenó a su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Niña abusadora; Gordo mentiroso. Edwin y Érica se pelean la custodia de una hija con un temperamento muy fuerte. Eduardo dejó a su hermano en México y años después se lo encuentra en Miami con otro género.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vagina box; Padre de su nieto. Adriana sale cubierta con una caja con agujeros en sus senos y su vagina para que le den propina. En otro caso, José es padre y abuelo del hijo de Elizabeth porque ella está presa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Madre drogadicta; Boba con senos. Georgina quiere recuperar la custodia de su hijo, pero el papá del niño alega que ella sigue en las drogas. Por otro lado, la hermana de Claudia se puso senos, pero la cirugía se complicó.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sin piso y sin fortuna; Reto al desnudo. El suegro de Stefany y Caterine es un delincuente de bienes raíces que las involucró. Por otro lado, Yasiel hizo el reto del desnudo con una chica y ahora la mamá lo amenaza y extorsiona.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Abandonado como un perro; Un amante es saludable. Jesús, como transeúnte, y Yadiel, como conductor, tienen un accidente en un paso peatonal. Además, Alessandra está deprimida y su terapeuta le recomienda tener un amante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La bella y el loco; Hermanas cómplices. Patricia fue acogida por Amador cuando llegó de Cuba, ahora él depende de ella. En otro caso, Claribel quiere que su hija María desaloje su casa, pues acusó de abuso a su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Caras vemos, corazones no sabemos; Muerte por accidente. Desde pequeña, Bárbara está clara de su bisexualidad, pero no encontró apoyo en su familia. Además, Jimmy y Mariela perdieron un hijo pequeño en un accidente de bicicleta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Soy una prostituta; Jugadas del destino. Yuneidis trabajó de mesera en un bar y escribió un libro sobre prostitución, pero su jefe la desmiente. También, la hija de Carla y Ángel necesita un donante de médula ósea con urgencia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Apariencias engañosas; Hermanos con derecho. Angélica es una transexual que estaba con su niño en un hotel, pero la denunciaron por abuso infantil. Los hijos de Cecilia y Juan duermen en la misma habitación y eso provoca problemas de pareja.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: ¿Quién responde?; Josefina la gobos. El hijo de Luis y Jéssica fue a una excursión al Amazonas y sufrió un accidente mortal. Además, Josefina es una travesti que fue abusada en la prisión de mujeres y en la de hombres.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Asesino de muñecas; Memorial Weekend. Bryan está obsesionado con los muñecos y contrata a Antonio para que sea el Ken de su esposa. Anthony trae a su novia de Nueva York para celebrar su cumpleaños, pero se pone celoso de un chico.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Amo a mi gordo; Tiamat, la mujer dragón. A Rasse le gusta que su pareja engorde, pero su esposo Jesús ya pesa 170 kilos y quiere bajar de peso por su salud. Tiamat tiene tatuajes y modificaciones corporales que molestan a su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Living History: Experiencing Great Events of the Ancient and Medieval Worlds

programme.title: Living History: Experiencing Great Events of the Ancient and Medieval Worlds
programme.desc: Oresteia: Judgment at the Dionysia. The Theater of Dionysis on a warm March day; one of the most astounding theatrical performances; Aeschylus's Oresteia is an innovative dramatic trilogy; the trial of Orestes is a relevant consideration of Athenian democracy at a time of great unease.

programme.title: Living History: Experiencing Great Events of the Ancient and Medieval Worlds

programme.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: Why Egypt Needed Hieroglyphs. Understanding why ancient Egypt has to invent some form of writing; central to this introduction is a study of the Narmer Palette; its writing sets standards and conventions that would be followed for 3, 000 years.

programme.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: The Ancient Egyptian Alphabet. Learning the hieroglyphic alphabet; how to write and position each hieroglyph, including a stylized hand, a horned viper and two hieroglyphs for which English does not have a letter; transcribing one's name from English to ancient Egyptian.

programme.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: How a Language Becomes Lost. Wondering how it is possible for a language used by the world's greatest civilization to become lost; charting the rise and fall of ancient Egypt's kingdoms; investigating the ways Christianity replaces hieroglyphs with Greek letters.

programme.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: Napoleon in Egypt. Exploring how hieroglyphs and the ability to read them are rediscovered during Napoleon's invasion of Egypt; considering the birth of Egyptology; the role of ushabtis, statues of servants that are buried with prominent Egyptians.

programme.title: Athenian Democracy: An Experiment for the Ages
programme.desc: Why Athenian Democracy Matters. Considering the nature of Athenian democracy; how it functions in practice; surveying some of its key tenets; Professor Garland compares the Athenian governmental system to western democracy today; he shows the similarities and crucial differences.

programme.title: Athenian Democracy: An Experiment for the Ages
programme.desc: The Origins of Greek Democracy. Among Greek city-states, Athens is not alone in having a form of democratic rule; Greek governments run on a sliding scale from oligarchy and democracy to kingship and tyranny; Homer's epics; examining several early examples of a democratic assembly.

programme.title: Athenian Democracy: An Experiment for the Ages
programme.desc: Solon: The Father of Democracy?. One must first examine Athens as a polis or city-state, within the broader context of Ancient Greece; reviewing the territory of Attica; the lay of the land for Athenian government in the 6th and 7th centuries B. C.; Solon's reforms.

programme.title: Athenian Democracy: An Experiment for the Ages
programme.desc: Cleisthenes the Innovator. Fifty years after Solon's reforms, a tyrant named Peisistratus seizes power; the overthrow of his tyranny; the ensuing skirmish among different aristocratic groups; the rise of Cleisthenes; he carries the democratic experiment forward.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Three Peoples Collide. Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: The Native Americans. Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40, 000 and 2, 000 B. C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Mayas, Aztecs, and Incas. The Aztecs and Incas create empires built upon religions of conquest; powered by the control of water, around Lake Texcoco in Mexico and high in the Andes Mountains, respectively; the Maya develops an advanced knowledge of astronomy and mathematics.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Europeans and Africans. Europe and Africa are connected for centuries by Old World trading networks centered around the Mediterranean; in the 15th century, Spain and Portugal shift the trade out of the Mediterranean and into the Atlantic, along the west coast of Africa.

programme.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years
programme.desc: 1990: America's New World Order. The end of the Cold War is a key point in history; the rapid collapse of the Soviet Union; the fall of the Berlin Wall; delving into the American story in the early 1990s; conflicts in Kuwait and Bosnia test America's new role in a post-Soviet world.

programme.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years
programme.desc: The Clintons and the 1990s. Bill Clinton's presidency dominates the domestic news in the 1990s. From his dramatic showdown with Newt Gingrich and the Republican Congress's Contract with America, this is a presidency of high drama; surveying the tumultuous decade.

programme.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years
programme.desc: A New Millennium, George W. Bush, and 9/11. The end of the Cold War may have reshaped the world order, but 9/11 and the subsequent war on terror changes America; tracing the events leading up to the terrorist attack on American soil on Sept. 11, 2001; learning why 19 hijackers attack America.

programme.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years
programme.desc: The US Wars in Afghanistan and Iraq. Historians discuss and debate the wars in Afghanistan and Iraq; the war in Afghanistan has some justification, given the role of Al-Qaeda in 9/11; Professor Allitt reviews the facts surrounding the war in Iraq; the war's effect on the United States.

programme.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment
programme.desc: An Overview of Democracy in America. The course begins with a brief overview of Tocqueville's masterwork; written to educate the French about democracy; it is originally published as two separate volumes, released five years apart.

programme.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment
programme.desc: Alexis de Tocqueville-A Brief Biography. William R. Cook introduces the young French nobleman, trained as a lawyer; his most famous book is only one achievement in a life marked by several; service as France's foreign minister; a history of the French Revolution regarded as a classic.

programme.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment
programme.desc: The Journey to America. Tocqueville rarely describes specific events or conversations; his letters and journals allow one to follow him on his trip; getting an excellent feel for the experiences he and his colleague, Gustave de Beaumont, have in America.

programme.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment
programme.desc: Equality of Conditions and Freedom. This lecture considers the meaning and implications of what Tocqueville introduces in the first paragraph of "Democracy in America"; the foundation of the democratic enterprise; the concept he calls equality of conditions.

programme.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era
programme.desc: 1865: "Bind Up the Nation's Wounds". The key historical forces that characterize the Gilded Age and the Progressive Era; the competing ideals that define these eras; the US in 1865; the extraordinary social, political and economic changes unleashed by the devastation of the Civil War.

programme.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era
programme.desc: The Reconstruction Revolution. The Reconstruction era following the Civil War; governmental policies and legislation enacted to safeguard the welfare of former slaves and average citizens; these policies are progressively dismantled, the South comes under the rule of the whites.

programme.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill Cody and the Myth of the West. programme.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era
programme.desc: Smokestack Nation: The Industrial Titans. programme.title: Conquest of the Americas

programme.desc: Naughty Sock Returns. Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Ned's Geraniums. The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Crabs - Digging in the Sand. The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Samira's Gymnastics. Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Milking Cows. The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Café Eggs. The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Café Eggs. The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Drumming with Norris. The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Making Fantastic Animals. Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies. They watch some children make fantastic animals from papermache.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Naughty Hat. Tinky Winky says "Eh-oh". The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be the Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hat. The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Gingerbread Boy. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Rabbits. Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Painting Easter Eggs. The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs. In Teletubbyland, Laa-Laa dances with her ball until the magical tree appears.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Turban. The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: My Dad's a Tram Driver. A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Football. The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Naughty Sausage. The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Number 3. The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Dentist. The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"
